A special place for dangerous material.

Information about the structure, drawing and site plan of the building.

Schedule of repair of life-saving systems and appliances.

Method of practical training and drill of staff.

Protective areas

The benefit of planning for protection from fire is that the fire-extinguishing staff know in which direction they have to go inside the building, and at which place what is built, e.g. store, room, washroom, stairs. From this the staff can be saved from dangerous material and can find this material and take it out. This planning not only helps in extinguishing fire and in access to dangerous material, but is also necessary for the safety of the fire-extinguishing staff.

Preventing fire from spreading

For fire to burn three elements are needed. These are heat, oxygen and fuel. Without heat, oxygen and fuel fire cannot burn. To stop fire from spreading, if one or more of these three elements is removed, the fire will go out.

1. Heat

During work heat is produced, e.g. heat is necessary to cook food in a pot or on a griddle. This heat should be kept under control and kept away from fuel. Heat is produced from different works. During this, work should be done with more attention. It is necessary that a checklist related to this work be made so that no work remains forgotten.

کام کے دوران حرارت پیدا ہوتی ہے مثلاً کھانا پکانے کیلئے پتیلی یا توے کیلئے حرارت ضروری ہوتی ہے۔ اس حرارت کو کنٹرول میں رکھا جائے اور ایندھن سے دور رکھا جائے۔ حرارت مختلف کاموں سے پیدا ہوتی ہے۔ اس دوران زیادہ توجہ سے کام لیا جائے۔ ضروری ہے کہ اس کام سے متعلق چیک لسٹ بنائی جائے تاکہ کوئی کام بھولے سے نہ رہ جائے۔
